name: Merckolumab
description: A humanized monoclonal antibody being evaluated for selected solid tumors with high PD-L1 expression.
mechanismOfAction: Binds PD-L1 and blocks interaction with PD-1, restoring T-cell mediated anti-tumor activity.

name: Sotivant
description: An oral kinase inhibitor indicated for a subset of patients with MET-altered non-small cell lung cancer.
mechanismOfAction: Selectively inhibits MET tyrosine kinase signaling that drives tumor cell proliferation and survival.

name: Cladribine analogue MK-441
description: A next-generation nucleoside analogue designed for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis.
mechanismOfAction: Preferentially depletes lymphocytes through disruption of DNA synthesis in highly dividing immune cells.

name: Evobrutinib follow-on
description: A covalent BTK inhibitor candidate intended to improve CNS exposure in progressive MS.
mechanismOfAction: Irreversibly inhibits Bruton's tyrosine kinase in B cells and myeloid cells involved in neuroinflammation.

name: Avelumab
description: A PD-L1 blocking antibody used in Merkel cell carcinoma and other selected malignancies.
mechanismOfAction: Binds PD-L1 on tumor and immune cells, interrupting immune checkpoint signaling.

name: Tepotinib XR
description: An extended-release MET inhibitor formulation aimed at once-daily dosing with a flatter exposure profile.
mechanismOfAction: Sustained MET kinase inhibition with modified-release pharmacokinetics to reduce peak-related adverse events.

name: Praziquantel micronized
description: An anthelmintic used against schistosomiasis, with a micronized formulation to improve bioavailability.
mechanismOfAction: Increases permeability of schistosome cell membranes to calcium ions, causing paralysis and death of the parasite.

name: Bintrafusp alfa analog
description: A bifunctional fusion protein combining TGF-β trap activity with PD-L1 blockade for checkpoint-resistant tumors.
mechanismOfAction: Neutralizes TGF-β in the tumor microenvironment while blocking PD-L1 to restore anti-tumor immunity.

name: Sprifermin topical
description: A recombinant FGF18 candidate being studied for cartilage repair in early osteoarthritis.
mechanismOfAction: Stimulates chondrocyte proliferation and extracellular matrix production via FGFR3 signaling.

name: Glucophage XR companion
description: An extended-release biguanide used as first-line therapy in type 2 diabetes when lifestyle measures are insufficient.
mechanismOfAction: Decreases hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity in peripheral tissues.
